subject: executor: tiny optimize index-lookup query performance by reuse lite-cop-worker. (#58586)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for kv/store changes in `pkg/kv/kv.go` and `pkg/store/copr/coprocessor.go`: `ClientSendOption.TryCopLiteWorker` switches from `*uint32` to `*go.uber.org/atomic.Uint32`, and lite-cop iterator now releases the CAS gate (`Store(0)`) once all tasks are finished to allow sequential reuse. Looked for correctness/consistency/concurrency/cancellation/protocol issues; the change only affects the lite-worker admission gate and uses proper atomic ops, with release occurring after task completion. No plausible Blocker/High issues found; later history up to `upstream/master` shows no follow-up changes to this gate/reset logic.
